title: band-limited-ml: band-limited maximum likelihood (BLML) density estimation
description: Code for band-limited maximum likelihood density estimation (real and complex roots, several modes; CPU and GPU), accompanying two papers: 'Taking Band-Limited Maximum Likelihood to High Dimensions: Linear Memory, the Parametric Rate, and a Self-Tuning Cut-off' and 'Complex band-limited maximum likelihood: estimating the wave behind detected quanta' (R. Agarwal and A. Agarwal).
